schemas.streamer_content:
CREATE TABLE `streamer_content` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `creator_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `platform` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `content_type` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `content_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `title` text,
  `description` text,
  `thumbnail_url` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL,
  `content_url` varchar(1024) NOT NULL,
  `published_at` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `fetched_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `metadata` text,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_platform_content` (`platform`,`content_id`),
  KEY `idx_creator_platform` (`creator_id`,`platform`),
  KEY `idx_published_at` (`published_at` DESC)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
schemas.ttt_chat:
CREATE TABLE `ttt_chat` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `match_id` int NOT NULL,
  `sender_name` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `sender_type` varchar(10) DEFAULT 'player',
  `message` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_match_time` (`match_id`,`created_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3
schemas.ttt_matches:
CREATE TABLE `ttt_matches` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `player_x` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `player_x_name` varchar(30) DEFAULT 'Player 1',
  `player_o` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `player_o_name` varchar(30) DEFAULT 'Player 2',
  `board` char(9) DEFAULT '---------',
  `current_turn` char(1) DEFAULT 'X',
  `status` varchar(10) DEFAULT 'waiting',
  `winner` char(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `rematch_x` tinyint(1) DEFAULT '0',
  `rematch_o` tinyint(1) DEFAULT '0',
  `last_move_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_status` (`status`),
  KEY `idx_player_x` (`player_x`),
  KEY `idx_player_o` (`player_o`),
  KEY `idx_updated` (`updated_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=6 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3
schemas.ttt_spectators:
CREATE TABLE `ttt_spectators` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `match_id` int NOT NULL,
  `spectator_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `spectator_name` varchar(30) DEFAULT 'Spectator',
  `chat_requested` tinyint(1) DEFAULT '0',
  `can_chat` tinyint(1) DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_match` (`match_id`),
  KEY `idx_spectator` (`spectator_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3
schemas.user_content_preferences:
CREATE TABLE `user_content_preferences` (
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `enabled_platforms` text,
  `content_types` text,
  `refresh_interval_hours` int DEFAULT '12',
  `max_items_per_creator` int DEFAULT '5',
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
schemas.user_saved_events:
CREATE TABLE `user_saved_events` (
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `event_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `event_data` longtext,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`,`event_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
